entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What's this favor you need? It's late[n]already.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll be going to Niijima's Palace,[n]so I want to look into her.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Things like her work ethic and[n]relationships. It doesn't matter[n]whether it's public or private.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Those would help us come up with[n]countermeasures in case we hit a[n]roadblock in her Palace.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I can look up more, you know.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Stuff like her repertoire of underwear.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A girl shouldn't say things like that!
What else can you dig up?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Also, I may be overthinking it, but my[n]voice—

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: *sigh* ...There's something else[n]we want you to look into.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: One more person has been on our mind.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If it's possible, I want to eavesdrop on[n]their phone conversation.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'd have to plant a bug directly on the[n]phone...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So it's impossible even for you...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I didn't say it was impossible!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'll plant an app that'll remotely hijack[n]the phone's transfer function!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But if it's through the internet, it'll leave[n]logs. So...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mmm... Okay! I've got a plan!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This is gonna be fun! I can't wait!
